label: SIMULATED second-contact evaluation (not production reopen data)
method: the drafter model (Qwen2.5-1.5B) role-plays the customer and writes one follow-up to the first reply; code checks whether the concern it raises (timing, amount, next step, confirmation, payment method) was already covered by the first reply. Preventable = the follow-up asks for something the first reply could have included.

CD-10401: Hello,

Thank you for reaching out regarding your issue with setting a new password on CloudDesk. Based on our verified facts, a new CloudDesk password should meet the following requirements:

- Must contain at least 8 characters.
- Should include at least one uppercase letter.
- Should include at least one lowercase letter.
- Should include at least one number.
- Cannot be identical to the previous password.

To proceed, please ensure your password meets these criteria before attempting to set it again. If you continue to experience issues, we recommend resetting your password using the process outlined in our article titled "Password Reset" [1]. This should help resolve any problems you're encountering.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
CloudDesk Support Agent
